provider.networkOptInMethod: Explicit user authorization in this conversation; two connected Bridge MCP Jev tool calls, sequentially. Local runner --allow-network is not used.
provider.userAuthorization: The user explicitly authorized using live Jev for MSSR testing in this conversation.

exposure.exactSourceRefOrSnapshotHadPriorExposure: The exact source and a compound related question were sent to Jev in the parent run.
exposure.interpretation: Same source and candidate set; linked diagnostic only, no independent inference or generalization.

comparison.metric: same three exact candidate handles per call; compare per-facet selection and token usage descriptively. Two calls are linked and correlated.

source.executionMode: Connected Bridge MCP calls are made directly by the host. The copied run template is used only for no-network input/source preflight; --allow-network is not used.

plan.pipeline: metadata sidecar -> source-scoped lexical search -> Jev exact-range choice -> exact fetch -> deterministic evidence pack
plan.metadataMode: sidecar exact-selector source scoping followed by source-local lexical candidates; same three revision-bound handles are offered in each request
plan.independentUnit: same architecture-impact source-document cluster as parent; linked atomic-query diagnostic, not independent samples
plan.excluded: No new semantic source cluster, no independent gold adjudication, no synthesis, paragraph composition, contradiction judgment, confidence calibration, or production threshold.

labels.adjudication: Same source-derived label as linked parent; no project-owner or independent expert adjudication.
labels.exposedSourceStatus: The source and related query facets were already sent to Jev in linked parent runs; exposed remediation diagnostic, never holdout evidence.
